title: Remove Diagnostics Tdarr console flat export
summary: Removed the Diagnostics Tdarr console transitional flat window export while preserving the namespace-backed mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView member, regenerated the WebView public contract, and updated flat-export inventory/current-state counts from 492 to 491.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat export cleanup by reducing direct window.* compatibility aliases only where namespace-first access is already guarded and tested.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js exported requestTdarrMatrixConsole both through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView and as a direct window.requestTdarrMatrixConsole compatibility alias. Inventories reported 492 flat exports total and 80 Diagnostics flat exports.
behavior_after: diagnosticsView.js keeps requestTdarrMatrixConsole on window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView but no longer assigns the direct window.requestTdarrMatrixConsole alias. Inventories and current-state docs report 491 flat exports total and 79 Diagnostics flat exports.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py asserts requestTdarrMatrixConsole remains namespace-exported and the flat alias assignment is absent.
manual_validation: rg -n "window\.requestTdarrMatrixConsole\s*=|typeof window\.requestTdarrMatrixConsole|window\.requestTdarrMatrixConsole\(" apps/desktop/webview/static tests Docs (only the negative regression assertion matched)
rollback_plan: Restore the removed window.requestTdarrMatrixConsole assignment, regenerate the WebView public contract and summaries, revert the flat-export count changes, and rerun the same WebView validation ladder.
